content: {"phoneNote": "The yellow schedule callout card at the bottom of the hero is awkwardly cut off by the dark section boundary and the fixed bar, and the basic info (time, location, age) is repeated three times down the page.", "desktopNote": "The layout is clean and atmospheric with clever trade-specific details like the lane-rope divider, though the key info bar and yellow schedule badge sit just below the initial 800px fold.", "phone": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 4, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 3, "distinctiveness": 4}, "desktop": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 5, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 4, "distinctiveness": 4}, "fixes": ["Fix the clipping of the yellow '17.00' card on mobile so the full number is visible and properly padded above the dark info strip.", "Reduce the vertical height of the desktop hero slightly so the dark info strip and yellow '17.00' badge are visible on the first screen without scrolling.", "Remove redundant questions from the FAQ section ('Kdaj poteka vadba?', 'Kje poteka vadba?') that merely repeat the facts already shown in the hero and info strip."]}
